h.strategy: Before writing hypotheses, decide which field values typically appear in strong configurations and which in weak ones. A condition that fixes such a value mostly selects strong (or weak) parents. Use this deliberately. Strong parents have little room left, so edits that usually help gain less there, and edits that usually hurt lose more. Weak parents sit near a floor, so harmful edits cost little and helpful edits gain a lot. Write at least six hypotheses where this quality effect predicts the opposite direction to the most obvious story about how the parts connect. Write the remaining ones on the strongest effects you are confident in. Use only conditions that many parents satisfy. Spread hypotheses across edited fields and edit values. In each 'why', name the quality mechanism.

hyps.why: A parent with nor_conv_3x3 on edge 1 is already a strong cell near the accuracy ceiling, so adding another 3x3 conv gains little.
Strong parents with a conv on edge 4 have little headroom, so the conv upgrade on edge 2 yields a smaller gain than in weaker parents.
A parent with edge 0 removed is already weak and near the floor, so removing edge 1 costs little, while in strong parents the removal loses a lot.
Replacing a none on the direct edge is the weakest starting point, so the conv upgrade gains much more than when replacing an already useful op.
Strong parents with a conv on edge 0 have the most to lose from a weak pooling op, whereas weak parents are already near the floor.
Replacing none with skip restores a path in a weaker parent, which gains more than swapping out an op in a parent that is already strong.
Parents with edge 1 removed are weak and have much room to improve, so adding a conv on edge 5 gains more than in strong parents.
Replacing a 3x3 conv with pooling removes a strong op, which costs far more than replacing a weak op with pooling.
Strong parents with a 3x3 conv on edge 3 have the most to lose from deleting an input edge, since weak parents are already near the floor.
A parent with nor_conv_3x3 on edge 5 is already near the ceiling, so an additional 3x3 conv on edge 1 adds little.
